narrative.overview: Lugta turns a dense reseller workflow into a bright, legible trade counter. Royal purple gives primary actions authority, vivid yellow marks rewards and progress, and cool working surfaces keep operational data easy to scan across RTL and LTR.
keyCharacteristics: Royal purple actions and vivid yellow emphasis.
Zain typography across Arabic, Kurdish, and English.
Compact rounded geometry with restrained ambient depth.
Complete light and dark modes with RTL/LTR parity.

rules.name: The Yellow Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks emphasis or reward; it never becomes the default page background or text color.

rules.name: The No White on Yellow Rule
rules.body: Text and icons over yellow always use dark ink.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Zain is the application typeface in Arabic, Kurdish, and English.

rules.name: The Ambient Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows separate working layers; they never become hard decorative blocks.

dos: Do use semantic palette roles from AppColors.
Do test every new surface in RTL and LTR.
Do keep all interactive targets at least 48dp.
donts: Don't restore the former green, cream, or gold visual vocabulary.
Don't place white text or white icons on yellow.
Don't use pure black as the dark-mode application surface.
Don't hard-code physical left/right layout when a directional equivalent exists.
